ui.cli.help:
Master Cleaner v{version} - cross-platform disk cleaner & optimizer (macOS / Windows / Linux)

Usage: mc <command> [options]

Commands:
  scan        Scan for reclaimable items   [--modules a,b] [--include-expert] [--info] [--roots ...] [--min-large 500MB] [--min-age 90] [--deep] [--json] [--save file] [--quiet]
  clean       Clean (default selection)     [--yes] [--dry-run] [--mode quarantine|trash|delete] [--select-all] [--only ids] [--modules a,b]
  run <id>    Run a scheduled task
  schedule    Scheduled tasks               list | add --name X --cron "0 3 * * *" --modules a,b --mode M | remove <id> | enable/disable <id> | install/uninstall <id>
  daemon      Stay resident, clean on schedule
  restore     Restore the safe vault        [record-id]
  vault       Vault management              list | purge [--older-than 30]
  serve       Start the local dashboard     [--port 43110]
  status      Overview (disk / vault / schedules)
  doctor      Environment self-check
  modules     List all modules
  legal       License, attribution and disclaimer

Examples:
  mc scan --json --save report.json
  mc clean --mode trash --yes
  mc schedule add --name "Daily AI cleanup" --cron "0 4 * * *" --modules ai-residue,dev-caches
  mc daemon
  mc legal

phrases..DS_Store、设备备份、本地快照与系统索引。: .DS_Store, device backups, local snapshots and system indexes.
phrases.WinSxS、Windows.old、内存转储、休眠/页面文件等大件检测。: Detect big-ticket items: WinSxS, Windows.old, memory dumps, hibernation/page files.

phrases.当前平台不支持此模块: This module is not supported on this platform

phrases.临时文件、缩略图/着色器缓存、崩溃报告、更新缓存等。: Temp files, thumbnail/shader caches, crash reports, update caches, and more.
phrases.仅清理聊天 / 社交 / 协作应用的使用痕迹（缓存、日志、临时文件），不清理登录: Cleans only usage traces of chat / social / collaboration apps (caches, logs, temp files); never login or chat records.
phrases.卸载应用并清除其缓存、偏好设置等残留。: Uninstall apps and clear their caches, preferences and other leftovers.
phrases.聊天 / 社交 / 协作应用的可重建缓存与临时痕迹清理，保留登录与聊天记录。: Clean rebuildable caches and temp traces of chat / social / collaboration apps, keeping login and chat records.
phrases.本软件会移动或删除文件（其中\"永久删除\"不可恢复），并可能执行外部清理命令。: This software moves or deletes files (“permanent delete” is unrecoverable) and may run external cleanup commands.
phrases.清理前请务必自行备份，并优先使用演练模式（--dry-run）核对。: Always back up first, and prefer the dry-run mode (--dry-run) to review.
phrases.本软件按\"现状\"提供，不附带任何担保；作者与贡献者不对数据丢失或其它损害承担: Provided “as is” without warranty; the authors and contributors are not liable for data loss or other damages.
phrases.完整条款见 DISCLAIMER.md 与 LICENSE。: See DISCLAIMER.md and LICENSE for the full terms.
phrases.已被占用，请用 --port 指定其他端口。: is in use; pass --port to choose another.
phrases.守护进程已启动，每 30 秒检查一次计划任务。: Daemon started; checking schedules every 30 seconds.
phrases.避免误删历史与模型: to avoid losing history or models
phrases.AI 会话记录、模型权重等「有价值的残留」默认不勾选，仅统计体积，避免误删历史与: AI session records, model weights and other “valuable residue” are not selected by default; only the size is reported, to avoid losing history or models.
phrases.项目构建产物默认不勾选；确认这些项目可重新构建后再清理。: Project build artifacts are not selected by default; confirm the project can be rebuilt before cleaning.
phrases.模型权重体积大，删除后需重新下载；如不再使用可手动勾选（移入回收站）: Model weights are large and must be re-downloaded if removed; select manually (moved to trash) only if unused.
phrases.包含历史对话与项目上下文，删除不可恢复，默认仅统计: Contains chat history and project context; deleting is unrecoverable, report-only by default.
phrases.包含应用数据，删除后应用需重新登录/下载: Contains app data; the app will need to sign in / download again after removal.
phrases.常规清理器看不到的隐藏占用：应用签名克隆、更新器残留、共享粘贴板归档、编译缓存与: Hidden usage ordinary cleaners never see: app signature clones, updater residue, Universal Clipboard archives, compiler caches and stale update packages.
phrases.应用自动更新器（ShipIt/Squirrel）中断后留下的解压目录；同一应用只: Unpacked staging dirs left behind by an interrupted app updater (ShipIt/Squirrel); only the newest copy per app is kept, the rest are treated as residue.
phrases.Universal Clipboard 跨设备复制时留下的暂存归档，超过 7 天: Staging archives left by Universal Clipboard; anything older than 7 days no longer participates in sync.
phrases.较新的跨设备复制归档，可能仍会被设备使用；确认不再需要时可手动勾选。: Recent cross-device clipboard archives that devices may still use; select manually only if you no longer need them.
phrases.用户级编译/着色器缓存，删除后由系统按需重建，只会让首次编译略慢。: Per-user compiler/shader caches; the system rebuilds them on demand, so only the first compile is slower.
phrases.应用自更新时下载的安装包，超过 48 小时仍未使用即视为失效；应用需要时会重新下: Installer packages downloaded by an app's own updater; anything untouched for 48 hours is treated as stale, and the app re-downloads it when needed.
phrases.浏览器组件更新时下载的安装包缓存，删除后按需重新下载。: Installer cache downloaded during browser component updates; re-downloaded on demand after removal.
phrases.安全清理会把文件先移动到隔离仓库；只有在「回收站」页清除后，磁盘空间才会真正释放: Safe cleaning moves files into the vault first; disk space is only actually freed after you purge them from the Vault view.
phrases.常规清理器不会进入这里：: Ordinary cleaners never enter this area:
phrases.上方可清理项均在此范围内。: The cleanable items above all live inside this area.
phrases.Gatekeeper 签名校验过程中产生的应用副本，校验结束后本应自动清理；这里: App copies produced during Gatekeeper signature verification; they should self-clean once verification ends. Only the newest copy is kept here, the rest are treated as residue. On APFS these copies may share data blocks with the original app, so the reported size can exceed the space actually freed. Location:
phrases.只清理已判定为残留的内容：同一应用仅保留最新一份签名克隆与更新器暂存，归档与缓存: Only content classified as residue is cleaned: one newest signature clone and updater staging dir per app is kept, while archives and caches are graded by age.
phrases.个最近产生、可能仍在使用的条目，其余判定为残留。: recently created item(s) that may still be in use; everything else was classified as residue.
phrases.签名克隆在 APFS 上可能与原应用共享数据块，统计值可能高于实际释放量，实际以: Signature clones may share data blocks with the original app on APFS; reported sizes can exceed the space actually freed, so trust the system's free-space change.
phrases.登录、会话与账户数据不在处理范围内；隐藏空间里的路径只在本机展示，不会上传。: Login, session and account data are out of scope; paths under hidden space are shown locally and never uploaded.
phrases.项目里的非源码残留：编辑器与合并残片、备份、日志、崩溃转储、AI agent 工: Non-source residue inside projects: editor/merge leftovers, backups, logs, crash dumps, AI agent tool caches and tool session output.
.DS_Store, Vim swap files and git merge leftovers (*.orig / *.rej / *~); removing them never touches project source.
phrases.匹配 *.bak / *.backup / *.old / *.save。这些可: Matches *.bak / *.backup / *.old / *.save. These may be deliberate backups, so confirm before selecting (moved to the safe vault by default, restorable).
phrases.构建、测试与工具运行日志；排障时可能有用，默认不勾选。: Build, test and tool run logs; may help debugging, so not selected by default.
phrases.进程崩溃时产生的 core 文件，仅用于事后调试；如无排障需求可清理。: Core files produced when a process crashes; only useful for post-mortem debugging. Clean them when you do not need to investigate.
phrases.Playwright CLI / MCP 在项目里留下的日志与快照，重新运行即可: Logs and snapshots left in the project by Playwright CLI / MCP; running it again regenerates them.
phrases.只包含 cache / tmp / logs / shell-snapshots: Only regenerable scratch sub-directories (cache / tmp / logs / shell-snapshots); settings, commands, memory, skills and worktrees are never touched.
phrases.agent 在项目里创建的 git worktree，可能包含未合并的改动，因此: Git worktrees created by agents inside the project; they may contain unmerged changes, so they are reported only and never cleaned:
phrases.个项目根（含 .git 或构建清单文件），共发现: project roots (with .git or a build manifest); found
phrases.只匹配高置信度残片（交换文件/合并残留/备份/日志/崩溃转储/工具缓存）；源代码: Only high-confidence debris is matched (swap files, merge leftovers, backups, logs, crash dumps, tool caches); source code, documents and untracked files are never guessed at.
phrases.个疑似凭据 / 会话 / 密钥文件，它们不会被列出或清理。: files that look like credentials / sessions / keys; they are neither listed nor cleaned.
phrases.Agent 工具目录只清理白名单内的临时子目录；settings、command: Inside agent tool dirs only allow-listed scratch sub-directories are cleaned; settings, commands, memory, skills, rules and worktrees are left untouched.
phrases.项目内的 agent 残留由「项目工作残留」模块处理：只清理可再生的缓存子目录，: Agent residue inside projects is handled by the Project work residue module: only regenerable cache sub-directories are cleaned; settings, commands, memory and skills stay untouched.
